title: Me RPG
blurb: A top-down action RPG: explore many varied worlds, fight, collect and level up, solo or online with a Dungeon Master.

title: Towercraft
blurb: A small real-time strategy game on winding roads: train units at your castle, build towers, upgrade, and destroy the rival castle. Three races. Duel an AI or a friend, or team up two against the computers where the roads fork. Early prototype.

title: Cats vs Birds
blurb: A rhythm runner: a cat dashes across a sunset bridge, jumping gaps and kiwis and staying low under birds, to collect tins of fish. Or play together online: one is the cat, the other flies the birds.
